valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: the same company (exportdevelopmentbankofegyptsae) is served under two keys, EGS60241C014.CA PS 1.69 and EXPA PS 1.76, and they disagree; one market capitalisation cannot be two, so neither multiple is verified. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so none of them is a valuation. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pegFormula: P/E divided by the growth rate of earnings, the growth rate expressed in percent
valuation.pegGrowthBasis: net profit compound annual growth of 72.74 percent a year from FY2021 (6.7753e+08) to FY2025 (6.033e+09), over 4 years
valuation.peFormula: market capitalisation / net profit, the same ratio as price / earnings per share; no share count is on file to show it per share
valuation.pbFormula: market capitalisation / total equity, the same ratio as price / book value per share; no share count is on file to show it per share
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2025
valuation.psFormula: market capitalisation / revenue, the same ratio as price / revenue per share; no share count is on file to show it per share
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2025, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.peEpsSource: the filed earnings-per-share row for FY2025
